gaps.wanted: A front view with the antennas removed. Every figure of the front draws the six detachable antennas on their connectors, so the connector centres and their height are read from the antenna bases and the legends and are estimated.

The antennas the guide names, Y0RGK0MA0AA for Wi-Fi and YECN009AA for 5G/LTE ('no other antennas are qualified'), as accessories: no document held gives their length or a dimensioned drawing, and the schema has no place for an accessory part number, so they are not drawn.
A square-on drawing of the lid. Only the guide's three-quarter views show it, so the pressed pads, the handle panel and the label recess are placed by proportion and are estimated.

Square-on drawings of the two sides. The guide's three-quarter view shows the left side with screws along it but not their positions, and no figure shows the right side, so four screws a side are drawn at the positions of celestica/es1010 and are estimated; the right side mirrors the left by assumption.
Any figure of the underside. None is held, so the face is declared empty with the search stated; a label, feet or vents may be there.
The vendor part number of the 1600 W supply. Neither the guide nor the datasheet names it, and the ordering table lists only chassis SKUs.
What the two round bosses left of fan labels 2 and 3 are. The guide documents no fan lamps; they are drawn as outlines only.

antenna-connectors.note: guide Front Panel Table 1 and Ports Table 5: 2 detachable Wi-Fi and 4 detachable 5G NR/LTE antennas, all SMA. In Front Panel figure 3 each is hidden behind its antenna base, so the connector centres are the antenna base centres read off the figure (x 61.6, 112.6, 163.6, 214.6, 265.7, 316.7 mm, a 51 mm pitch) and the height is set level with the ANT legends (6.0 mm). Drawn as std/sma@1, the library's SMA jack. The legends ANT1 and ANT2 (with the Wi-Fi mark) and 5G ANT1 to ANT4 sit to the left of each antenna (the figure stacks '5G' over 'ANT1', drawn so; the Wi-Fi mark is drawn as three strokes). The vent fields around the antenna row are hidden behind the antenna bases in the figure, so the band holding the connectors and their legends (y 2.0 to 9.6 above RJ45 blocks 1-2 and 4) is drawn as flat metal, an estimate. See the antenna-connector-positions gap.

body-faces.note: Top, left, right and bottom are sized from the chassis block (438.2 wide, 43.4 high, 371.6 deep, the guide's System Overview). Their contents are read off the guide's System Overview three-quarter figures 3 and 5 by eye: the lid is light grey with a handle panel and pressed pads, the left side carries screws. Four screws a side follow celestica/es1010, the right side is assumed to mirror the left, and the underside is shown by no figure. See the lid-feature-positions, side-screw-positions and underside gaps.

chassis.note: datasheet PHYSICAL DIMENSIONS: 43.4 x 438.2 x 371.6 mm. The guide's Key System Specifications agrees (371.6 deep) and gives 8 +/- 0.5 kg with two supplies. 438.2 is the body between the ear folds: the guide's front figure draws the grey ears outside it.

colours.note: Sampled from the guide's figures away from text and ports: Front Panel figure 3 faceplate #222222 (average of three patches under and beside the legends); Rear Panel figure 2 body #a9aaac (average of patches between fans and supplies and at the left edge); System Overview figure 3 lid #d3d6db. The rear fan grille averages #595b5b in the figure, a dark field with a light honeycomb, which the dark backing and grille drawn here match.

fans.note: '2+1 fixed fans' (datasheet FEATURES); 'three (3) fans' (guide Rear Panel). Not field-replaceable, so decor plus a region each, as on celestica/es1010 and es1000.

front-figure.note: Guide Front Panel figure 3 (EG1050-48CP, an orthographic CAD render, 5436 x 2417 px): the body measures 4855 px across for 438.2 mm, 11.08 px/mm, and 477 px high for 43.4 mm. The same face as the 48-port front of celestica/es1000: the RJ45 column pitch (13.96), block pitch (92.0), the uplink and management cluster and the lamp column agree with that device's measured front to 0.5 mm, so its positions are used. The face differs in the EG1050 model plate, the green stripe under ports 1-16 and the six antenna connectors.

legends.note: every legend as printed in Front Panel figure 3: port pairs 'N ▲▼ N+1' centred under each column, those of ports 1-16 inside the green stripe; MGMT COMBO with its bracket; the arrowhead over the management SFP lamp; IOIOI under the console; STAT, FAN, PWR, ALM beside the lamps; the SuperSpeed mark beside each USB-A. The Celestica wordmark is plain text. The model plate is the dark pull-out tab printed EG1050 with LUG TAG under it, the seated celestica/lug-tag-ridge-23@1.

poe.note: guide System Overview: 'All Ethernet data ports support 802.3bt Type 4 Class 8 (90W) PoE'; datasheet FEATURES lists the same as an option and 'persistent PoE'. Per-port budget with two supplies is not printed for this model.

port-leds.note: guide LEDs Table 3: each data port has a left link lamp (green at 2.5GbE on ports 1-16, amber at the lower speeds) and a right activity lamp that is amber while PoE power is enabled; each SFP28 port has one bi-colour lamp (green 25G, amber 1/10G); STAT, FAN, PWR and ALM are Table 1.

port-speeds.note: guide Ports Table 5 and datasheet FEATURES: ports 1-16 are 100/1000/2500BASE-T (the figure marks them with the green stripe under their numbers), ports 17-48 are 10/100/1000BASE-T, all 48 with PoE++; four SFP28 at 1/10/25G; management RJ45 10/100/1000 and management SFP 1000 Mbps, one combo interface.

power.note: guide Key System Specifications, Power Consumption: 'EG1050-48CP, ES1050-48CP, ES1010-48CP: <3200W', an upper bound with no ambient or load, filed as max.

psu.note: guide System Overview table: PSU 2 x 1600W for the EG1050-48CP, F2B and B2F. The rear figure draws the supply with a black tab and two lamps, which is the face of celestica/psu-crps-1600-ac. Neither the guide nor the datasheet names a supply part number.

rear.note: Guide Rear Panel figure 2 (EG1050) is the same rear art as figure 1 (ES1010 and ES1050) with the six front antennas standing behind the chassis. It is drawn as celestica/es1000's rear, which was measured off the same art: three fixed fans with round honeycomb grilles at 50.14, 105.59 and 161.09 mm, two CRPS bays at 256.0 and 346.3 (73.5 x 40), the divider between them, the earth screws at the left edge and in the right strip. Two round bosses beside fan labels 2 and 3 are outlines only. The rear carries no connector of its own.

stack-orientation.note: rule, not a reading: the SFP28 pairs (upper 0 over lower 180) follow the library's belly-to-belly convention. The figure draws the cage lips in the lamp band between the rows, which is what the convention draws.

uplink-cluster.note: Front Panel figure 3 against celestica/es1000's measured cluster: SFP28 2 x 2 bezel 375.0 to 403.5 x 10.5 to 35.1, management SFP 355.6 to 370.7, USB-A 329.1 to 342.2, the stacked management RJ45 / USB-A / console shell 407.0 to 423.6 and four round lamps at x 428.8 (STAT, FAN, PWR, ALM). The figure shows the SFP28 up/down lamp triangles in the band between the stacked cages.
